units.source_text: 婚后第二天他就斥责妻子说：“刚一进门就浪费是不可以的啊。”

en.t: On the second day after the wedding, he scolded his wife, saying, "It is not acceptable to start wasting money the moment you come into the household."

units.source_text: 然而，这种斥责的话，与其说是他自己要说的，毋宁说是他的姑妈让他“说”的。

en.t: Yet those words of reproach were less something he wanted to say himself than something his aunt made him "say."

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，他的妻子不仅向他本人，也向他的姑妈道了歉。

en.t: Without a doubt, his wife apologized not only to him personally, but also to his aunt.

units.source_text: 为他买来的那盆黄水仙花就摆在妻子前面……

en.t: The pot of yellow daffodils she had bought for him was set right in front of his wife...
